content:
elliot: opening a small docs PR to add an 'Airgap KMS: Helm hook + Ansible provisioning + QA checklist' section. Aim is pragmatic operator recipes (helm post-install hook for cert bootstrap, ansible task for provisioning proxy, CI smoke tests for offline bundle). Need infra + ops + security eyes.

priya: nice. can you include a helm hook example that runs after install to curl the KMS health endpoint via the proxy and fails the release if it can't reach it? that helps catch misconfig in CI.

elliot: yep adding a simple helm hook (Job) snippet and a tiny Ansible task to place the KMS CA and set env on the install node. PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5438 (WIP).

marco: please call out support for both iptables and nft, and a short note about kube-proxy/ipvs differences (some ipvs setups need a host SNAT rule). also flag any behavior that changes handshake timeout defaults.

elliot: good call. i'll add a line: "If using kube-proxy in IPVS mode, ensure SNAT rules exist on the node or use a hostNetwork sidecar for proxy egress."

doc-bot: link-checker: found outdated anchor in /installers/airgap_kms.md -> #old-proxy-config. Suggested replacement: /private/kms-proxy.md#env-vars.

qa: include a CI smoke test example that can run inside the offline environment: verify offline bundle checksum, run helm install --wait, run the helm hook job, assert logs contain 'kms: key fetch succeeded'. small github-actions snippet is helpful.

elliot: adding a sample GH action matrix entry for 'airgap-smoke' that runs inside a VM with the offline bundle mounted. will include commands to run the helm-job and grep example lines.

elliot: helm hook job snippet:
```yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: kms-proxy-smoke
  annotations:
    "helm.sh/hook": post-install,post-upgrade
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: smoke
        image: curlimages/curl:7.80.0
        env:
        - name: HTTPS_PROXY
          value: "http://kms-proxy.kms.svc.cluster.local:3128"
        command: ["/bin/sh","-c","curl --silent --fail --proxy $HTTPS_PROXY https://kms.internal/healthz || exit 1"]
      restartPolicy: Never
```

elliot: Ansible task snippet to drop CA and set env for installer node:
```yaml
- name: install KMS CA
  copy:
    src: files/kms-ca.pem
    dest: /etc/redwood/kms-ca.pem
    mode: '0644'
- name: set installer env file
  lineinfile:
    path: /etc/redwood/installer.env
    line: 'KMS_PROXY_URL=http://10.0.100.5:3128'
    create: yes
```

marco: add the MTU troubleshooting note for HSMs: if HSM uses UDP/CMP and you see packet loss, try `ip link set dev <egress> mtu 1400` on the egress node and re-run smoke. Include expected error lines `tls: handshake failure` or `icmp fragmentation needed`.

security: ensure we say not to store raw TLS private keys in repo; recommend sealed secrets or KMS-backed secret storage. also confirm any systemd examples avoid printing sensitive env vars in stdout.

elliot: added sealed-secrets guidance and a systemd override sample that uses EnvironmentFile with restricted perms. will redact examples in support docs.

qa: for the CI action, include a small checksum verification step for the offline bundle: `sha256sum -c offline-bundle.sha256` and fail early if mismatch. also suggest caching vendor tarballs (node/gems) and validating their sha.

elliot: including vendor checksum checklist. also adding a tiny note about IPv6: if the private VPC uses IPv6 for KMS, use curl -6 in the smoke hook and mention dual-stack SNAT caveats.

doc-bot: lint: please use triple backticks with language tags for YAML and sh blocks. link-checker: suggested anchor update already noted.

priya: small request: add explicit rollback steps in the doc for the helm/ansible flow: how to unset KMS_PROXY_URL, remove cert, restart systemd unit, and re-run helm upgrade. keep them one-liners.

elliot: adding rollback one-liners: `sed -i '/KMS_PROXY_URL/d' /etc/redwood/installer.env && systemctl restart redwood-installer`, `helm uninstall my-release && helm install ...` etc.

marco: can we also add an example iptables->nft migration quick-check command so operators can validate which tool is active? e.g., `which nft && nft list ruleset || iptables-save`.

elliot: added that check and a tiny troubleshooting table: failure symptom -> likely cause -> quick fix. splitting PR into two commits: (A) helm/job + ansible + CI smoke, (B) link fixes + security/rollback notes. tagging @priya @marco @security for review.

qa: i'll try the GH action smoke in staging after the PR hits draft->ready. please ping with the offline bundle link.

elliot: thanks all. marking draft and will update per comments. :raised_hands:
